items.title: Support for nature-based climate pledges builds slowly
items.summary: Novo Nordisk’s new commitment , announced Sept. 15, calls for the company to source commodities such as wheat, corn, soy, cattle, sugar beets and wood from locations that are “conversion-free” — meaning natural habitat wasn’t destroyed for the sake of new production.

items.title: Project developers can now sign up for Verra’s Scope 3 registry
items.summary: The world’s largest issuer of voluntary carbon market credits is gearing up to launch a registry for an emerging type of credit that’s used to decarbonize supply chains.

items.title: Busting the myth that newer carbon credits are superior
items.summary: The opinions expressed by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis . Companies often try to buy relatively new carbon credits, sometimes those no more than five years old.

items.title: Top 20 private equity firms’ portfolios pollute more than most countries, research finds
items.summary: The energy portfolios of the top 20 private equity firms emit more pollution than every country except the US, China, India and Russia, a report from the Private Equity Climate Risks Consortium has found.

items.title: Bristol bans high-carbon advertising on council-owned sites
items.summary: Bristol City Council will no longer allow advertising for petrol and diesel cars, hybrid vehicles, SUVs, flights, fossil fuel companies and certain fast fashion campaigns on council-owned advertising sites.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: In a week's time, edie will hold its new webinar exploring how organisations can turn circular economy commitments into practical, measurable action across the business value chain.

items.title: Nominations open for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027
items.summary: edie’s 30 Under 30 is back for 2027, celebrating ambitious young professionals turning sustainability ambition into meaningful action across business.

items.title: Report: UK clean energy transition faces £511bn investment challenge by 2040
items.summary: The UK will need at least £511bn of investment between 2026 and 2040 to deliver its clean energy transition, according to a report commissioned by Standard Life and Santander.

items.title: CCC warns Heathrow expansion has no credible climate pathway under current policies
items.summary: Heathrow Airport expansion cannot be reconciled with the UK's climate commitments under current policies, according to advice from the Climate Change Committee (CCC).

items.title: How to cut through the noise at New York Climate Week
items.summary: Happening on 20-27 September, Climate Week NYC is just around the corner.
